description: Use this after search_listings when the user wants the full details of one Homejourney listing, such as its description, size, tenure, furnishing, availability, nearest MRT, nearby schools, the MRT stations open or under construction, primary schools by 1 km and 2 km band, secondary schools, supermarkets, hawker centres, CHAS clinics, parks, malls, bus stops with their bus numbers, and childcare centres and preschools near it, and Homejourney link. For an owner listing, including a flat its owner lists on HDB Flat Portal, it adds reportUrl, where the user reports a wrong, misleading or scam listing to Homejourney. For an HDB rental, tenantEligibility says who may rent it: the 6-month minimum, the pass a non-citizen needs and, for a whole flat, the HDB non-citizen quota with a link to the HDB quota checker; use it when the user is a PR or a foreigner. Never returns owner or agent contact details.
name: get_listing_details

bathrooms.description: The whole home's bathrooms; for a let room, read room.ownBathroom.

bookingUrl.description: Where the user asks for a viewing. Absent when that page takes no request: the owner books on a portal (reach.bookOn says where) or no request reaches anyone.

depositMonths.description: Details and compare, for an owner rental: the security deposit in months of rent, as the owner stated it. Null when not stated; partner listings carry none.

descriptionSource.description: Who wrote description: generated means Homejourney wrote it from the listing's photos and data, so say so when quoting it and never present it as the lister's words; listing means the lister wrote it; null with no description.

facing.description: Details only: which way the main windows face, as the owner states it (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W or NW).

financing.description: Details only, for a sale listing: the financing figures its web page shows at the asking price and lease, for a Singapore citizen's first home with no other loans. primary is the bank loan; options adds the HDB loan for an HDB flat when its lease allows one; when a 75% HDB loan would need more than HDB's S$16,000 family income ceiling, that option is the largest loan a household at the ceiling repays, with incomeCap set. grossIncomeNeeded is the monthly income a loan needs under incomeLimitLabel (MSR for an HDB flat, else TDSR) at stressRatePct. buyerStampDuty, legalFees and totalUpfront (down payment, BSD and legal fees, no ABSD) are in S$. buyerAge is the youngest buyer's age assumed; estimate_mortgage_options takes another age or residency. Null for a rental.

floorplans.description: Details only: published floor plan image URLs.

gcbArea.description: Details only: the URA Good Class Bungalow area a landed home stands in, from its location, such as Kilburn Estate; null outside every area. The Ministry of Law has approved no foreign buyer, PRs included, for one since 2021.

hdbFlatType.description: For an HDB flat in search, details and compare: its flat type, such as 4-room or executive, inferred from its block's resale records and its size. Absent when no single type matches, so treat that flat's type as unverified and never infer it from bedrooms.

hdbFlatTypeUnknownReason.description: For an HDB flat without hdbFlatType: why its type is unverified. no_block and no_block_records: its block has no HDB resale records yet; no_size_match: its size matches no flat type in its block's records; ambiguous: its size fits more than one flat type in its block; no_size: the listing gives no floor area; room_size_only: a let room's listing gives only the room's size, not the flat's.

hdbLease.description: Details and compare, for an HDB flat: its block's lease start year, the lease left this month and the block's age in years, as in lease; kept for earlier clients. Null when unknown.

houseRules.description: Details and compare: the house rules the listing states, such as {"pets": false, "cooking": true} (true allowed, false not allowed) or rules in words such as ["no_smoking"]. An owner rental may add "tenants", who the owner says the home suits (families, couples, working_professionals, students); none is no preference. Empty or null when it states none.

imageCount.description: The listing's public photos in total. images holds the first 8, so when this is more, tell the user the listing url shows them all.

imageLabels.description: One per image, in order: the tag to show with an owner's edited photo, or null for an unedited one.

lease.description: Search, compare and details, for every home: its tenure, the lease left this month and its age from TOP, as the listing page shows them. An HDB flat's lease comes from its block's resale records, and its age from HDB's year completed when the block has no resale yet; a condo, EC or landed home's from URA's records of its land lease, not its TOP. remainingLabel is 'Lease start not confirmed' for a leasehold whose start is not found, and null for freehold and 999-year homes. Null when nothing is known.

minRemainingYears.description: Only for an HDB flat whose lease start is not confirmed: the fewest whole years that can be left, from its block's year completed. min_remaining_lease_years uses it; it is not the lease left.

startYear.description: The year the lease began; null when not confirmed.

tenureLabel.description: Such as 99-year lease from 2000, or Freehold; null when the tenure is not known.

listedAt.description: When the listing was first shown publicly.

listingCluster.description: Search only: this result stands for listingCount listings one agent lists at one address (scope address) or in one development (scope development), itself and otherListingIds, priced minPrice to maxPrice. Absent for a listing no other on this page or the next joins. The listings may be different homes, since an agent can list two flats in one block; pass an id to get_listing_details to tell them apart.

listingsOnThisPage.description: Present when some of them are on the next page: how many are on this one. The next page leaves those out and names this result in continuedClusters.

maxOccupants.description: Details only, for a rental: the most people who may live in the home or room, 1 to 20. Null when not stated.

nearbyPlaces.description: Details only: the places the listing page shows near the block. mrtStations (code, name, walkMinutes), futureStations (stations under construction within 1.5 km: name, lines, openingYear as LTA expects it or null when not dated, walkMinutes), primarySchoolsWithin1Km and primarySchools1To2Km (the Primary 1 registration bands), secondarySchools, supermarkets, hawkerCentres (within 2 km) and clinics (CHAS clinics within 1 km, type gp or dental), the last three with name, place and walkMinutes, parks (NParks parks within 1 km of their nearest edge: name, areaHectares, walkMinutes), malls (shopping malls within 2 km from OpenStreetMap: name, walkMinutes; credit "© OpenStreetMap contributors" when you show them), busStops (LTA bus stops within 400 m: code, name, place as the road, services as the bus numbers that call there, walkMinutes; credit "Contains information from LTA DataMall" when you show them) and preschools (ECDA-licensed childcare centres, kindergartens and early years centres within 1 km: name, place, walkMinutes; credit "Contains information from ECDA" when you show them), each with distanceKm. Distances are straight-line from the block and walks are estimates; for Primary 1 registration, the user checks the exact distance on OneMap SchoolQuery.

price.description: SGD; monthly rent for a rental.

priceReason.description: Details only: the owner's own words on why the home is priced as it is.

renovationYear.description: Details only: the year the owner last renovated.

rentComparison.description: Details only, for a whole-home rental: how its rent compares with the typical rent of homes like it, as its web page's rent line says. monthlyRent is the median monthly rent in S$ of the last 12 months' recorded whole-home rentals like it: the same bedroom count in its development, or for an HDB flat the same flat type on its street, in any block. rentals is how many, fromMonth and toMonth (YYYY-MM) the months they span, and basis names them. askingVsTypicalPct is the listing's rent above (positive) or below (negative) that median, in percent to one decimal. Null for a sale, a room, or below five matching rentals.

reportUrl.description: Details only: for an owner listing, the listing page with its Report this listing form open, where the user tells Homejourney the details or photos are wrong, it isn't the owner's, it's gone or it looks like a scam. For a flat its owner lists on HDB Flat Portal, the same form takes only that it's gone or its details are wrong. The user sends the report themselves; null for other listings.

requestedListing.description: Details and compare: the id asked for when it is one portal's listing of this home, such as an agent's own listing from search_agents, which Homejourney shows as this listing (id). platform and price are that portal's; sourceAgents names each portal's agent. Use id for viewings and saves.

room.description: For a rental that lets a master room, common room or bed space: the room itself, which its card shows in place of the flat's bathrooms and floor area. Null for a whole home, a studio or a sale.

label.description: Master room, Common room or Bed space.

ownBathroom.description: True for an attached bathroom, false for a shared one, null when not stated.

squareFeet.description: The room's own size; null when not stated, never the flat's.

searchedSchool.description: Search with school only: {name, distanceKm}, that school and its straight-line distance from the block, or null when the home does not list it nearby. For Primary 1 registration, the user checks the exact distance on OneMap SchoolQuery.

seller.description: Details only, for an owner listing: whether the owner verified with Singpass, their weekly viewing hours (Singapore time, weekday 0 is Sunday; empty when none are open), and how many minutes they usually take to first answer a viewing request (null until they have answered at least 3).

squareFeet.description: Floor area. A let room may give the flat's here, as every owner's does; read room.squareFeet for the room's own size, null when the listing gives only the flat's.

storeyRange.description: Details only: HDB's three-storey band, such as 13 to 15, never the exact storey.

typicalRent.description: Details only, for a sale listing: the typical rent and gross yield its web page shows. monthlyRent is the median monthly rent in S$ of the last 12 months' recorded whole-home rentals like it: the same bedroom count in its development, or for an HDB flat the same flat type on its street, in any block. rentals is how many, fromMonth and toMonth (YYYY-MM) the months they span, and basis names them. grossYieldPct is monthlyRent × 12 ÷ the asking price, leaving out costs, vacancy and ABSD. Null for a rental, or below five matching rentals.

utilitiesIncluded.description: Details only, for a rental: whether the rent includes utilities (true) or not (false). Null when the listing does not say.

nextSteps.description: Suggestions for what the user usually does next, best first. Each names the tool to call or the page to open; none is taken without the user asking, and a tool that writes still needs their confirmation.

replyText.description: This reply as text: what it found, the next step, and every id or link a follow-up call needs. Read it before answering the user.

title: Get Homejourney listing details
